title.narrative: EcoCajou – Cashew processing in Northern Côte d'Ivoire

description.narrative: This project aims to contribute to a competitive and inclusive cashew sector in Kabadougou, Northern Côte d'Ivoire.By improving efficiency, the project will create 1,000 permanent jobs with fair working conditions for the workers, of which over 60% are female.In addition, it will provide a stable income for 3,300 smallholder farmers, processors and service providers, and contribute to the development of an ecologically sustainable cashew production.
